title: Commercial mining pilot tests of the SAR technique under NDA
summary: Filippo tells of Commercial mining pilot tests of the SAR technique under NDA, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I did a lot of pilot tests with companies. Uh-huh. And uh more than 100% successful.

plain: A researcher named Filippo, who uses a radar scanning technique to look beneath the ground, says he ran many trial tests of it for mining companies under secrecy agreements. He says the results were more than 100% successful. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast to back up his claim that the technique can reveal what lies underground, such as beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
